name: Shokushu Taikan no Mahou Shoujo ☆ Yuuri
original_name: 触手胎姦の魔法少女☆ユーリ
source:
Yuri is the only magic girl who works to combat the isekai tentacle invasion.
Though she fought tirelessly, she was still a novice magic girl, and her wet holes
get drilled repeatedly by slippery tentacles, as they writhe in pleasure!

But these were not ordinary tentacles.
They targeted the wombs of human women to plant a "core" in them,
and multiple their numbers through forced birthing...!

Though Yuri ahe-cried as she was forced to birth tentacles, her senpai Keito
decided to enjoy the mad pleasure that birthing tentacles brought...!?

translation:
Yuri是唯一一名负责对抗异世界触手入侵的魔法少女。
她不知疲倦地战斗，却仍是初出茅庐的魔法少女；湿润的肉穴被滑腻的触手反复贯入，在扭动的快感中不断受辱！

可这些并不是普通触手。
它们瞄准人类女性的子宫，将“核心”植入其中，再通过强制分娩来增加自身数量……！

Yuri被迫生下触手，哭喊着发出淫声；她的前辈Keito却决定享受生育触手所带来的疯狂快感……！？
